amendment_rule: Sealed before the first MARKET freeze it governs. Any further change is another dated addendum.

promotion_rule.text: MW-H1 replaces MW-B1 as the headline only if, over >= min_days matured freeze days counted from effective_from_anchor_day, its paired Brier skill vs MW-B1 at the +/-15% width (1 - Brier(MW-H1) / Brier(MW-B1) over the same rows) is >= min_skill with the moving-block 95% CI (whole freeze days, the standard's block_days and resamples, seed = the standard's seed + seed_offset) entirely above 0, AND it is not worse (point estimate) at +/-5% or +/-35%. A promotion is a new sealed model version, never back-applied.

title: Market Weather addendum: the MW-H1 challenger is published before its windows open, and only those rows can earn its promotion

what_changes.archive: Every MW-H1 row with an earlier anchor day is published once, at seal time, in the archive file named under 'archive' below, marked NOT pre-registered. Those rows are never counted in any test or promotion.
what_changes.promotion_test: The mw_v1_1 promotion rule for MW-H1 is unchanged in every threshold, but it counts ONLY MW-H1 rows with anchor_day >= effective_from_anchor_day. Its >= 120 matured freeze days are counted from that day. Every verdict reports the test, pass or not.
what_changes.publication: From effective_from_anchor_day (the first MARKET freeze after this addendum is sealed, filled in at seal), every MW-H1 row is published in that day's MARKET pre-registration manifest under challengers.MW-H1, with its own batch_root and per-row prediction_hash, before its window opens. The public verifier (verifier/verify_manifest.py) checks those rows like the champion's.

what_does_not_change: The champion MW-B1, its published rows, the mw_v1 verdict rule, the MW-IV1 challenger (its values have always been published inside the champion rows as c_p_*), the grid, and family addenda 1 to 3.
what_was_wrong: MW-H1, the second challenger added by mw_v1_1 (sealed 2026-09-23), has been frozen daily for every coin since anchor day 2026-09-24, each row written before its window opened and hashed - but kept only in GradedLP's private store. No MW-H1 row was ever placed in a public pre-window manifest. So nothing public proves when any MW-H1 forecast was made, and the mw_v1_1 promotion test could have promoted a model whose record is not publicly pre-registered. Found in a GradedLP internal audit on 2026-10-13; disclosed here.
